knowledge:
- key_parameters: genome=Specifies the genome assembly (e.g., "hg19", "hg18", "mm10", "mm9") to build the ideogram track ;; which=A GRanges or filter object specifying the genomic region of interest to subset or zoom the data ;; gap.geom=Controls the intron geometry in gene models (e.g., "chevron" or default straight line) ;; stat=Statistical transformation, such as "reduce" to collapse features or "mismatch" to calculate mismatch proportions ;; columns=Character vector of metadata columns to retrieve from annotation databases ;; names.expr=String expression to customize labels using retrieved metadata columns ;; geom=Explicitly overrides semantic zoom to force a specific representation (e.g., "segment", "rect", "text", "gapped.pair") ;; heights=Numeric vector in tracks() specifying the relative heights of each track
- alternatives: OrganismDb vs TxDb vs EnsDb vs GRangesList for gene models: OrganismDb is recommended because it supports gene symbols and column combinations as labels. EnsDb supports gene symbols, filtering, and AnnotationFilter. TxDb does not support gene symbol labeling directly (defaults to tx_id). GRangesList is a flexible fallback when no pre-built annotation package is available, allowing users to parse custom tables (e.g., from GTF files).
- when_to_use: Use this package when you need to visualize genomic features (genes, transcripts, exons, introns), alignments (BAM files, coverage, mismatches), variants (VCF files), and genomic overviews (circular plots, karyograms, grandlinear/Manhattan plots) in a unified, ggplot2-compatible track layout.
- pitfalls: Using TxDb objects directly will not support gene symbol labeling (defaults to tx_id). When using GRangesList for gene models, the object must contain a column (defaulting to 'type' or mapped via aes(type = ...)) containing keywords like 'cds', 'exon', 'intron' (case-insensitive). For mismatch proportion visualization (stat = "mismatch"), a reference sequence (BSgenome object) must be provided via the bsgenome argument. Semantic zoom automatically hides or changes geoms based on width; if data is not visible, zoom in or explicitly override the geom parameter.

workflows.name: genomic_tracks_construction_and_navigation
workflows.intent: Build and navigate a multi-track genomic visualization containing an ideogram, gene models, alignment coverage/mismatches, and variants.
workflows.stages: 1. Create an ideogram track using Ideogram() ;; 2. Build a gene model track from an annotation database (e.g., Homo.sapiens, TxDb, or EnsDb) using autoplot() ;; 3. Load reference sequence from a BSgenome object and configure semantic zoom ;; 4. Build an alignment track from a BAM file using autoplot(), optionally calculating mismatches with stat = "mismatch" ;; 5. Build a variants track from a VCF file or VRanges object using autoplot() ;; 6. Combine all tracks into a single visualization using tracks() and customize heights and themes ;; 7. Navigate the tracks using zoom(), nextView(), or prevView()
workflows.code:
library(ggbio)
p.ideo <- Ideogram(genome = "hg19")
p.ideo

library(GenomicRanges)
p.ideo + xlim(GRanges("chr2", IRanges(1e8, 1e8+10000000)))

library(Homo.sapiens)
class(Homo.sapiens)
data(genesymbol, package = "biovizBase")
wh <- genesymbol[c("BRCA1", "NBR1")]
wh <- range(wh, ignore.strand = TRUE)

p.txdb <- autoplot(Homo.sapiens, which = wh)
p.txdb

autoplot(Homo.sapiens, which = wh, label.color = "black", color = "brown", fill = "brown")
autoplot(Homo.sapiens, which = wh, gap.geom = "chevron")
autoplot(Homo.sapiens, which = wh, stat = "reduce")
columns(Homo.sapiens)
autoplot(Homo.sapiens, which = wh, columns = c("TXNAME", "GO"), names.expr = "TXNAME::GO")

library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene)
txdb <- TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene
autoplot(txdb, which = wh)

library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v75)
ensdb <- EnsDb.Hsapiens.v75
autoplot(ensdb, GeneNameFilter("PHKG2"))
autoplot(ensdb, ~ symbol == "PHKG2", names.expr="gene_name")
gr <- GRanges(seqnames = 16, IRanges(30768000, 30770000), strand = "*")
autoplot(ensdb, GRangesFilter(gr), names.expr = "gene_name")
autoplot(ensdb, GeneIdFilter(c("ENSG00000196118", "ENSG00000156873")))

library(biovizBase)
gr.txdb <- crunch(txdb, which = wh)
colnames(values(gr.txdb))[4] <- "model"
grl <- split(gr.txdb, gr.txdb$tx_id)
names(grl) <- sample(LETTERS, size = length(grl), replace = TRUE)
grl
autoplot(grl, aes(type = model))
ggplot() + geom_alignment(grl, type = "model")

library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19)
bg <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19
p.bg <- autoplot(bg, which = wh)
p.bg
p.bg + zoom(1/100)
p.bg + zoom(1/1000)
p.bg + zoom(1/2500)
autoplot(bg, which = resize(wh, width = width(wh)/2000), geom = "segment")

fl.bam <- system.file("extdata", "wg-brca1.sorted.bam", package = "biovizBase")
library(GenomeInfoDb)
wh <- keepSeqlevels(wh, "chr17")
autoplot(fl.bam, which = wh)
autoplot(fl.bam, which = resize(wh, width = width(wh)/10), geom = "gapped.pair")
p.mis <- autoplot(fl.bam, bsgenome = bg, which = wh, stat = "mismatch")
p.mis
autoplot(fl.bam, method = "estimate")
autoplot(fl.bam, method = "estimate", which = paste0("chr", 17:18), aes(y = log(..coverage..)))

library(VariantAnnotation)
fl.vcf <- system.file("extdata", "17-1409-CEU-brca1.vcf.bgz", package="biovizBase")
vcf <- readVcf(fl.vcf, "hg19")
vr <- as(vcf[, 1:3], "VRanges")
vr <- renameSeqlevels(vr, value = c("17" = "chr17"))
gr17 <- GRanges("chr17", IRanges(41234400, 41234530))
p.vr <- autoplot(vr, which = wh)
p.vr
p.vr + xlim(gr17)
p.vr + xlim(gr17) + zoom()
autoplot(vr, which = wh, geom = "rect", arrow = FALSE)

gr17 <- GRanges("chr17", IRanges(41234415, 41234569))
tks <- tracks(p.ideo, mismatch = p.mis, dbSNP = p.vr, ref = p.bg, gene = p.txdb, heights = c(2, 3, 3, 1, 4)) + xlim(gr17) + theme_tracks_sunset()
tks

tks + zoom()
